crossRefs.note: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five…

translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
